source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This landing makes archiveMessages await destination-folder setup and makes continueBatch await missing archive subfolders. The method then starts the filter/copy batch chain without awaiting that chain; exhausted-batch cleanup invokes oncomplete. The inspected extension caller therefore waits for oncomplete in its own Promise and ignores the archiveMessages return. The filter completion callback still calls continueBatch without await despite the review discussion. Initial setup rejection has no reset handler in this inspected method; no native failure, cancellation or full error-recovery behavior was exercised.
title: Archive setup and batch completion use different asynchronous signals
